source_refs.note: Topic 4.1.8.2 Properties of Graphs (PDF 113-114, printed 110-111). The degree question uses the edges of Figure 4.12; the sum rule is general knowledge, flagged.

items: Degree: the number of edges connected to a vertex; a city joined to three cities has degree 3.
Weight: a value on an edge such as distance or cost; a 50 km road can have weight 50.
Direction: directed edges are one-way (a road from A to B need not return), undirected edges are two-way.
